Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step2-item2: 2. Find the input box that says 'Insert your link here'.
Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step2-item3: 3. Paste the link by clicking the 'Paste' button or by pressing 'Ctrl + V' (or 'Cmd + V' on Mac).

Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step3-item2: 2. Wait a few seconds for the media to process and be prepared for download.
Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step3-item3: 3. Once ready, choose the download quality and format.
Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step4-item1: 1. Select the download option that appears and confirm the quality you want.
Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step4-item2: 2. The media will download to your device's default location or ask where to save, depending on your browser settings.
Translations-Douyin.howToUse-step4-item3: 3. That's it! You now have the media saved on your device for viewing anytime.
